notes.title: Update ver1.0.3
notes.notes: [p]The following updates have been made to ver1.0.3.[/p][p][/p][h2]Gamepad (Xbox) Support[/h2][p]This update supports gamepad (Xbox) operation![/p][p]The game also supports real-time device changes. If you have both a keyboard & mouse and a gamepad, you can switch devices at any time you like![/p][p][/p][h2]Improved comfort[/h2][list][*][p]Until now, the puzzle on the induction table (puzzle table) was automatically solved the moment you stored more than the required value on the induction table, but a new "trade button" has been introduced to prevent it from being solved automatically.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]In the battle tutorial, you can no longer swing your sword unless you take the required steps.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]In order to make it clear at a glance whether you are concentrating, we have improved it so that the "Mist Stance" motion is inserted when you are concentrating.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug fixes, etc.[/h2][list][*][p]Hotfix for the issue where the induction table would not be released even if you stored the same amount of value as the required value of the induction table.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Other minor fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update ver1.0.2
notes.notes:
The following corrections and adjustments have been made.
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where concentration analysis was not performed correctly when concentrating on another fallen warrior after successfully dispelling evil spirits or performing an Iaido-slash.
[*] Changed the required value of some guidance platforms.
[*] Adjusted the volume of Hannya's voice.
[*] Overall adjustment of initial volume.
[*] Lowered the lower limit of each volume adjustment bar.
[/list]

The development team has also confirmed the following issues. We will address them as soon as we find the cause.
[list]
[*] Problem where the guidance platform is not released even if the same amount of value as the required value of the guidance platform is paid.
[*] Problem where item respawning does not work properly under certain conditions.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Begins on Steam – May 21!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that the early access release date for the horror game "Kyosho - 虚衝", which was previously postponed from December 25, 2024, has been officially rescheduled for May 21, 2025.

Originally planned for release on December 25 last year, the game’s launch was delayed due to the store approval process. We have now successfully passed the review, and the new early access date is confirmed.

Initially, early access was to feature only a selection of chapters. However, thanks to updates made during the delay, the early access version will now include all chapters, significantly expanding the game’s volume and content at launch.

We remain fully committed to delivering the best possible experience to our players.
Thank you for your continued support of Kyosho - 虚衝!
